text: Given no X-Linear-Api-Key header, When any tool is called, Then the server returns 401 naming the required header and makes no call to Linear
Given a valid API key, When linear_list_teams is called, Then the response contains the teams visible to that key, each with id/key/name

Given a workspace with more teams than the default page size, When linear_list_teams is called with no cursor, Then has_more is true and next_cursor is set; calling again with that cursor returns the next page
Given a valid API key and a team_id, When linear_list_issues is called with that team filter, Then every returned issue belongs to that team
Given a known issue identifier, When linear_get_issue is called, Then the response includes title, description, state, assignee, labels, project, team, and URL
steps: Obtain a Linear personal API key for a test workspace with at least one issue
Call linear_get_issue with that issue's identifier (e.g. ENG-1) via the running MCP server (curl POST /mcp, tools/call)
expect: Result includes non-null title, description, state.name, assignee (or null if unassigned), labels (array, possibly empty), project (or null), team.key, and a url starting with https://linear.app/
evidence: needs a real vendor account — no Linear test workspace/API key was available during design; dev leg to run and attach evidence

text: Given an issue identifier that does not exist, When linear_get_issue is called, Then the response is a structured not_found error, not a 500 and not an unhandled exception

Given a valid API key, a team_id, and a title, When linear_create_issue is called, Then the response contains a new id/identifier/url, and a subsequent linear_get_issue on that identifier shows the submitted title
steps: In a disposable test team in a Linear test workspace, call linear_create_issue with team_id and a distinctive title
expect: linear_create_issue returns a non-null id/identifier/url; linear_get_issue on that identifier returns the exact title submitted
evidence: needs a real vendor account — write-path test against PROD-equivalent Linear API must use a disposable test workspace/team, not run blind; dev leg to execute with evidence (response bodies)

text: Given linear_create_issue is called without a team_id, When the call is made, Then the response is a structured invalid_argument error
Given an existing issue, When linear_update_issue is called with a new state_id, Then the response shows the new state, and a subsequent linear_get_issue confirms it
steps: Using the issue created in TC7 (or another disposable test issue), call linear_update_issue with a different valid state_id for that team
Call linear_get_issue on the same identifier
expect: linear_update_issue's response state matches the requested state; linear_get_issue confirms the same state afterward
evidence: needs a real vendor account; dev leg to execute with evidence

text: Given an existing issue, When linear_create_comment is called with a body, Then the response contains a comment id, and the comment is visible on that issue in Linear
steps: Using a disposable test issue, call linear_create_comment with a distinctive body text
Open the issue in the Linear web app (or re-query comments via the API) and look for the comment
expect: linear_create_comment returns a non-null comment id; the comment with the exact body text is visible on the issue
evidence: needs a real vendor account; dev leg to execute with evidence

text: Given Linear responds 429 with Retry-After, When any list/get tool call hits this mid-request, Then the service retries honoring the delay, and if still rate-limited the final response is a structured rate_limited error

Given two requests are issued concurrently to the running HTTP server with two different X-Linear-Api-Key values pointed at two different (mocked) Linear accounts, When both are in flight, Then each response contains only its own account's data
Given the container has no Linear credential environment variable set at all, When a request omits the header, Then the server still 401s rather than falling back to any operator credential
Given a team with zero issues, When linear_list_issues is called with that team filter, Then the response is an empty issues array with has_more false, not an error
Given linear_update_issue is called with an out-of-range priority value, When the call is made, Then the response is a structured invalid_argument error and the issue is left unchanged
